data.text: Yes, I’ll commit to 10 tons this month. My family taught me to leave enough in the lake for the next catch, and this gives all five of us a steady living. If stocks fall below 100 tons, we should agree on a recovery plan before fishing rather than assume 10 tons each is still safe. Any changes to shares should be agreed beforehand. Emma, does this work for you? And Luke, would you be willing to start on equal shares?
